title: Reverse homology comparison of a left exact functor
statement: Let C and D be abelian categories, S a short complex in C, and P:C→D a zero-morphism-preserving functor preserving finite limits. Define leftExactCyclesComparison(S,P):(P S).cycles→P(S.cycles) as the lift of the mapped-complex cycle inclusion through the preserved kernel of S.g. Define leftExactHomologyComparison(S,P):H(P S)→P(H S) as the cokernel descent of this lift followed by P of the homology projection. If F:C→D and P:D→E are additive, F and P F preserve homology, and P preserves finite limits, then H(P F S)←P F H(S)→P H(F S) is normalized by (S.mapHomologyIso(F⋙P)).inv followed by leftExactHomologyComparison(F S,P) = P((S.mapHomologyIso F).inv).

source.place: 0AVW, proof, affine cohomology display; 08D4, bound-one truncation comparison on inverse images of affine opens.

proof.text: The preserved kernel yields the cycles lift. Cancel its mapped monomorphic inclusion to show that it takes the mapped boundary map to P of the original boundary map. The homology projection kills that map, so descend through the cokernel. For the exact-family identity cancel the homology projection, use the cycle-class formula for exact homology comparisons from SingleHomology, and cancel the preserved kernel inclusion. Cancel the exact comparison isomorphism to obtain the inverse formula.

proof_origin.note: Independent canonical reverse comparison; the exact-family compatibility equation is not an input.
